description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. Our database platform offers developers the fastest and most reliable Postgres and Vitess+MySQL databases, enabling businesses to efficiently handle data and workloads of all scales. 

 We also take DX seriously. Our platform enables developers with deep performance insights, AI integration, powerful cluster management, and schema migration tooling.

 Our customers trust us with what is often their most precious digital asset: their data. The stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Developer Educator who is excited about bringing database education to new heights, creating unique and engaging content, helping customers, and building the PlanetScale engineering community at conferences, events, and online.

 The job

 
 Create technical content to help customers and engineers at-large learn how Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and the PlanetScale ecosystem works

 Speak at conferences and events, representing PlanetScale in the database and engineering community

 Create and refine product documentation

 Host livestreams and webinars to engage with and educate our community

 Your role may contain between 20-50% travel to connect with developers at events worldwide

 
 The ideal candidate

 
 Teaches complex technical concepts in accessible ways

 Loves learning about and explaining full-stack application development, databases, and compute infrastructure

 Is a natural communicator who can adapt your message for different audiences

 Thrives in community settings and enjoy building relationships with developers

 Has excellent writing skills and can produce content that engineers actually want to read

 Is self-motivated and can manage multiple projects independently

 Enjoys experimenting with new ideas to further the education and marketing mission on PlanetScale

 
 What you will need

 
 2+ years of experience in engineering, solution architecture, technical education, or developer relations

 Strong understanding of relational databases (Postgres or MySQL)

 Proven ability to create technical content (samples of blog posts, tutorials, documentation, or speaking engagements)

 Experience speaking at conferences or hosting technical presentations and events

 Willingness to travel between 20-50% of the time

 
 What else will help you be successful

 
 Experience with Vitess or other distributed database technologies

 Knowledge of distributed systems and database scaling challenges

 Previous experience at a database or infrastructure company

 
 Why PlanetScale

 We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale. We work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Developer Educator, you'll be at the core of educating our customers to effectively use the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale’s hiring philosophy is centered around building small teams of p99 individuals.

 At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work. We strive to build an environment where people feel that they are respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee.

 Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

 An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

 Base salary range: $130,000 - $200,000 USD
